name: Google Business Profile
label: Google Business Profile — locations, reviews, local posts
description: Official Google Business Profile APIs. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Reviews and localPosts stay on https://mybusiness.googleapis.com/v4. location_get uses per-op baseUrl https://mybusinessbusinessinformation.googleapis.com path /v1/locations/{location_id} with readMask (https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/businessinformation/rest/v1/locations/get). OAuth bearer access_token (scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage). GBP APIs are access-gated: unapproved Cloud projects have zero default quota. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. location_get / review_list need account_id + location_id. review_reply also needs review_id + comment. post_create needs summary + topicType (languageCode optional). Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"location_get","account_id":"123","location_id":"456"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: location_get | review_list | review_reply | post_create | trigger.

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: GBP account id path segment (accounts/{account_id}/…). Falls back to config account_id. Example: '123456789'.

schema.label: location_id
schema.description: Location id path segment. Required for HTTP ops. Example: '987654321'.

schema.label: readMask
schema.description: Required FieldMask for location_get (Business Information API v1). Comma-separated fields, e.g. 'name,title,storefrontAddress'. https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/businessinformation/rest/v1/locations/get

schema.label: comment
schema.description: Owner reply text for review_reply. Required. Example: 'Thank you for visiting.'.

schema.label: summary
schema.description: Local-post body for post_create. Required. Example: 'Open late this Friday.'.

schema.label: topicType
schema.description: LocalPost topicType for post_create. EXACT Google enums: STANDARD | EVENT | OFFER | ALERT. This node only sends languageCode, summary, topicType — EVENT/OFFER extra objects are not in bodyFrom. Prefer STANDARD.

schema.label: Page token
schema.description: review_list pageToken from the previous page.

schema.label: Order by
schema.description: review_list orderBy. EXACT: updateTime desc | updateTime | rating desc | rating.

schema.label: Media
schema.description: LocalPost.media [{mediaFormat, sourceUrl}]. post_create. mediaFormat: PHOTO | VIDEO.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). trigger returns the BPMN message-event instruction — it does not open a socket. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (Location, reviews list, ReviewReply, or LocalPost).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: location_get | review_list | review_reply | post_create | trigger.

configurationParameters.label: OAuth access token
configurationParameters.description: Google OAuth 2 access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage. Never log or place on INPUT. This engine does not refresh tokens.

configurationParameters.label: Account ID
configurationParameters.description: Default GBP account id used when input.account_id is blank (path accounts/{account_id}/…). Example: '123456789'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) supporting URL key, X-SQ-WEBHOOK-KEY header, or k/{keyId} with provider secret header.

configurationParameters.label: Pub/Sub Push Auth Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider webhook secret verified in constant time against inbound header Authorization. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
configurationParameters.description: HTTP header name carrying the provider webhook secret (default: Authorization).
